acceptanceCriteria: The stable row carries tier, anchors, path:lines and a bounded quoted span, orders unknown/self-only/anchor-less hunks first, and a golden shows 03a8ca10-style maps as distinguishable from an anchored map.
body:
Panel finding (outcome lens). internal/cem/workflow/review_projection.go:435 renders a stable hunk row as evidence hash + relation + drift. On 03a8ca10 (sealed 2026-10-12) the report shows 445/445 "supported; evidence-backed" while `cem status --citation` shows anchored 0, specificity 0, samePathCitations 439/445. The reviewer report and the MCP preview are the only surfaces a reviewer reads, so the one signal cem/1.0 adds never reaches them. Relates to V1-0195 (hunk-anchored review projection).

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
